project.title: Standardised Tax Documentation & Filing Workflow Rollout
project.objective: Design and roll out a standardised, audit-ready tax documentation and filing workflow across departments.
deliverables: Mapped end-to-end tax documentation and approval workflow
Standard templates for tax-relevant documents and checklists
Centralised tax documentation tracker and filing calendar
Guidelines for inter-department data handover and responsibilities
Training materials and quick-reference guides for staff
Post-rollout compliance and process effectiveness report
constraints: Must comply with current tax legislation and internal audit rules
Go-live before the next quarterly tax filing deadline
Use existing office and spreadsheet software only
Minimal disruption to ongoing accounting and finance operations
All changes must be documented and version-controlled
Process must be understandable for non-finance staff

risks.risk: Departments provide incomplete or late financial data for tax preparation.
risks.mitigation: Define clear data deadlines, responsibilities, and automated reminders in the tracker.

risks.risk: Staff resist new templates and workflow changes.
risks.mitigation: Involve key users in design, run short trainings, and collect feedback for quick adjustments.

risks.risk: Misinterpretation of tax legislation in the new workflow.
risks.mitigation: Have tax clerks review all templates and steps against current regulations before rollout.

risks.risk: Spreadsheet-based tracker becomes inconsistent or duplicated.
risks.mitigation: Assign ownership, lock structure, and define a single source of truth with access rules.

themes.why_relevant: Core goal is to ensure filings are accurate, timely, and fully supported by documentation.
Different teams must follow the same steps so tax clerks can work efficiently.
Good templates reduce errors and rework in tax calculations and filings.
Clear RACI avoids gaps and overlaps in tax-related tasks.
Staff need guidance to adopt the new process without slowing daily operations.

backlog.task: Map current tax documentation and filing processes across departments
definition_of_done: Interviews held with accounting, finance, and operations contacts
Process map drafted showing steps, owners, and tools
Bottlenecks and duplicate steps identified and documented
Map reviewed and validated by at least one tax clerk

backlog.task: Design standard templates for tax-relevant documents and data collection
definition_of_done: List of required tax documents and data fields compiled
Draft templates created for invoices summary, deductions, and adjustments
Templates checked against tax legislation requirements
Templates approved by accounting department representative

backlog.task: Create a centralised tax documentation tracker and filing calendar
definition_of_done: Spreadsheet tracker structure defined with status, owner, and due dates
Quarterly and annual filing deadlines entered
Access granted to relevant departments
Test run completed for one upcoming filing cycle

backlog.task: Define roles and responsibilities for each step in the new workflow
definition_of_done: RACI matrix drafted for tax documentation and filing steps
Reviewed with tax clerks and finance manager
Final version approved and stored in shared location
Summary shared with all impacted teams

backlog.task: Draft tax documentation and filing guidelines
definition_of_done: Guideline document outlines required documents, formats, and deadlines
Examples of correct and incorrect documentation included
Reviewed for clarity by a management assistant
Published in shared knowledge repository

backlog.task: Prepare and deliver short training sessions for staff
definition_of_done: Training agenda and slides prepared
At least two sessions scheduled with key departments
Attendance recorded and materials shared afterwards
Feedback collected and summarised

backlog.task: Pilot the new workflow on one monthly tax filing
definition_of_done: Pilot scope and participants agreed
All pilot documents processed using new templates and tracker
Issues and deviations logged
Pilot review meeting held and actions captured

backlog.task: Adjust templates and guidelines based on pilot feedback
definition_of_done: Feedback from pilot consolidated
Template and guideline updates implemented
Changes communicated to management assistants
Version history updated in documentation

backlog.task: Set up reminder and escalation rules for missing tax data
definition_of_done: Reminder schedule defined for each key deadline
Escalation contacts identified per department
Reminder text templates drafted and approved
First cycle of reminders tested via email or messaging

backlog.task: Compile post-rollout compliance and process effectiveness report
definition_of_done: Data collected on on-time submissions and error rates
Comparison made between old and new process metrics
Key findings and recommendations documented
Report shared with accounting and internal audit

backlog.task: Maintain and update statutory books alignment with new workflow
definition_of_done: Review of statutory books requirements completed
Checklist updated to reflect new documentation flow
Alignment confirmed with tax clerks
Next review date scheduled

backlog.task: Document incident handling procedure for tax-related discrepancies
definition_of_done: Common discrepancy scenarios listed
Step-by-step resolution procedure drafted
Approval obtained from finance manager
Procedure stored and linked in guidelines

threads_plan.thread_goal: Align on current pain points and approve target tax workflow scope.
threads_plan.trigger: Kickoff message announcing the tax workflow standardisation project.

mandatory_decisions.decision: Agree on the departments and processes included in the initial workflow scope.
Confirm owner for maintaining the workflow map and RACI matrix.

threads_plan.thread_goal: Design and sign off templates, tracker, and checklist for tax documentation.
threads_plan.trigger: Tax clerk shares first draft of templates and asks for feedback.

mandatory_decisions.decision: Approve the standard templates for tax-relevant documents.
Agree on the structure and mandatory fields of the tax documentation tracker.

threads_plan.thread_goal: Lock roles, responsibilities, and reminder/escalation rules.
threads_plan.trigger: Management assistant posts draft RACI and reminder plan.

mandatory_decisions.decision: Approve the RACI matrix for the new tax workflow.
Confirm reminder frequency and escalation contacts for missing data.

threads_plan.thread_goal: Plan and debrief the pilot run of the new workflow.
threads_plan.trigger: Tax clerk proposes a specific monthly filing as the pilot.

mandatory_decisions.decision: Select the filing period and scope for the pilot run.
Agree on changes to templates and guidelines after pilot feedback.

threads_plan.thread_goal: Coordinate training sessions and final rollout communication.
threads_plan.trigger: Management assistant shares draft training slides and rollout timeline.

mandatory_decisions.decision: Confirm training dates and mandatory attendee groups.
Approve final go-live date for the new tax workflow.

channel_rituals: Daily async check-in each morning with yesterday's progress and today's focus on tax workflow tasks.
Twice-weekly status update summarising tracker changes and upcoming tax deadlines.
Post-pilot retrospective thread to capture lessons learned and improvement ideas.
Pre-filing checklist review one week before each major tax deadline.
End-of-project wrap-up summarising outcomes and linking to final report and guidelines.
